pathwayGroup: Rural and Francophone Community Immigration Pilots
pathwayGroup_tr: Kırsal ve Frankofon Topluluk Göç Pilotları
pathwayGroup_zh: 农村与法语社区移民试点
structuralNote: Iki ayri ama surec olarak buyuk olcude ortusen pilot program: RCIP (genel, 14 topluluk) ve FCIP (Fransizca konusan, 6 Francophone-minority topluluk). Ayni surec/belge/ucret iskeletini paylasiyorlar, sadece topluluk listesi ve dil sarti farkli.
structuralNote_tr: Süreç açısından büyük ölçüde örtüşen ancak ayrı iki pilot program: RCIP (genel, 14 topluluk) ve FCIP (Fransızca konuşan, 6 Frankofon azınlık topluluğu). Aynı süreç/belge/ücret iskeletini paylaşırlar; yalnızca topluluk listesi ve dil şartı farklıdır.
structuralNote_zh: 这是两个在流程上高度重叠但彼此独立的试点项目：RCIP（通用，14个社区）和 FCIP（法语，6个法语少数族裔社区）。它们共享相同的流程/材料/费用框架，只是在社区名单和语言要求上不同。
sharedEligibilityCore: Valid job offer from a designated employer in a participating community
At least 1 year (1,560 hours) of related work experience in the past 3 years
Approved language test proving language ability
Canadian educational credential or foreign equivalent
Proof of sufficient funds to support self and family
sharedEligibilityCore_tr: Katılımcı bir topluluktaki belirlenmiş işverenden geçerli iş teklifi
Son 3 yılda en az 1 yıl (1.560 saat) ilgili iş deneyimi
Dil yeterliliğini kanıtlayan onaylı dil testi
Kanada eğitim belgesi veya yabancı dengi
Kendini ve ailesini destekleyecek yeterli fon kanıtı
sharedEligibilityCore_zh: 来自参与社区指定雇主的有效工作邀约
过去3年至少1年（1,560小时）相关工作经验
证明语言能力的合格语言测试
加拿大教育证书或其外国等同学历
证明有足够资金支持本人及家人

sharedProcessSteps.name: Get a job offer
sharedProcessSteps.description: From a designated employer in one of the participating communities

sharedProcessSteps.name: Get a community recommendation
sharedProcessSteps.description: Employer sends recommendation application to the community; community verifies job is in priority sector, offer is genuine, and applicant meets pilot requirements

sharedProcessSteps.name: Apply for permanent residence
sharedProcessSteps.description: Online via PR Portal, after community recommendation received

sharedProcessSteps.name: After you apply
sharedProcessSteps.description: AOR issued, biometrics + medical exam requested

sharedProcessSteps_tr.name: Topluluk tavsiyesi alın
sharedProcessSteps_tr.description: İşveren tavsiye başvurusunu topluluğa gönderir; topluluk işin öncelikli sektörde olduğunu, teklifin gerçek olduğunu ve başvuru sahibinin pilot şartlarını karşıladığını doğrular

sharedProcessSteps_tr.name: Daimi oturum için başvurun
sharedProcessSteps_tr.description: Topluluk tavsiyesi alındıktan sonra PR Portal üzerinden çevrimiçi

sharedProcessSteps_tr.name: Başvurudan sonra
sharedProcessSteps_tr.description: AOR düzenlenir, biyometri ve sağlık muayenesi istenir

sharedProcessSteps_zh.name: 获得工作邀约
sharedProcessSteps_zh.description: 来自参与社区之一的指定雇主

sharedProcessSteps_zh.name: 获得社区推荐
sharedProcessSteps_zh.description: 雇主将推荐申请提交给社区；社区核实职位属于优先行业、邀约真实且申请人符合试点要求

sharedProcessSteps_zh.name: 申请永久居留
sharedProcessSteps_zh.description: 在收到社区推荐后，通过 PR Portal 在线申请

sharedProcessSteps_zh.name: 提交申请后
sharedProcessSteps_zh.description: 将发出 AOR，并要求采集生物识别信息和体检

conditionalForms.name: Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union
conditionalForms.condition: If applicant has a common-law partner, plus 12+ months cohabitation proof

conditionalForms.name: Separation Declaration for Minors Travelling to Canada
Use of a Representative
conditionalForms.condition: If using paid or unpaid representative

conditionalForms.name: Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual
conditionalForms.condition: If releasing application info to a non-representative third party

supportingDocuments: Valid regular passport (NOT diplomatic/official/service/public-affairs) + visa copy if residing outside passport country
Marriage/divorce/annulment certificates (all marriages if more than once)
Death certificate for former spouse(s) if applicable
National ID / family registry book if applicable
Police certificate per country lived in 6+ months since age 18 (valid ~1 year from issue)
Photo(s) for applicant + all family members (even non-accompanying), not older than 6 months
sharedDocuments.translationRule: Any supporting document not in English/French needs: (1) a certified-translator-stamped translation OR a signed affidavit from the translator if no certified translator available, AND (2) a scan of the original or certified photocopy. Family members and the applicant's own immigration representative CANNOT serve as the translator.
sharedDocuments.translationRule_tr: İngilizce/Fransızca olmayan destekleyici belgeler için: (1) onaylı tercüman kaşeli çeviri veya onaylı tercüman yoksa tercümanın imzalı beyanı ve (2) orijinalin ya da onaylı fotokopinin taraması gerekir. Aile üyeleri ve başvuru sahibinin kendi göçmenlik temsilcisi tercüman olamaz.
sharedDocuments.translationRule_zh: 任何非英语/法语的支持文件都需要：（1）带有认证译员印章的翻译，或在没有认证译员时由译员签署的宣誓书；以及（2）原件或经认证复印件的扫描件。家庭成员和申请人自己的移民代表不能担任译员。

canDo: fill forms and communicate via their own account
cannotDo: open a portal account on applicant's behalf

canDo: help open a PR portal account

canDo_tr: kendi hesapları üzerinden form doldurup iletişim kurabilir
canDo_zh: 通过他们自己的账户填写表格并沟通
cannotDo_tr: başvuru sahibi adına portal hesabı açamaz
başvuru sahibinin kimlik bilgileriyle giriş yapamaz
cannotDo_zh: 不能代申请人开设门户账户
不能使用申请人的凭据登录

informalHelper.note: Someone helping without being a 'representative' doesn't need to be disclosed, AS LONG AS they don't advise on which program to apply for, complete/update the application as the applicant, or act as the applicant when dealing with IRCC.
informalHelper.note_tr: 'Temsilci' olmadan yardımcı olan biri, hangi programa başvurulacağı konusunda tavsiye vermediği, başvuruyu başvuru sahibi adına doldurup güncellemediği ve IRCC ile işlem yaparken başvuru sahibi gibi davranmadığı sürece beyan edilmek zorunda değildir.
informalHelper.note_zh: 如果某人只是提供帮助而不属于“代表”，只要其不就申请哪个项目提供建议、不以申请人身份填写或更新申请，也不在与 IRCC 交涉时冒充申请人，则无需申报。

representativeRules.legalSignatureRule: Regardless of representative type, the applicant must personally type their own name after reading the declaration - this is the legal definition of 'signed' under Canadian immigration law.
representativeRules.legalSignatureRule_tr: Temsilci türü ne olursa olsun, başvuru sahibi beyanı okuduktan sonra kendi adını bizzat yazmalıdır; Kanada göçmenlik hukukunda 'imza' bunun yasal karşılığıdır.
representativeRules.legalSignatureRule_zh: 无论代表类型如何，申请人在阅读声明后都必须亲自输入自己的姓名——这在加拿大移民法中即构成“签名”的法律定义。

biometrics.note: Required even if previously given and still valid
biometrics.note_tr: Daha önce verilmiş ve hâlâ geçerli olsa bile gerekir
biometrics.note_zh: 即使之前已采集且仍然有效，也仍然需要

afterApply.qualityAssuranceReview: Applications may be randomly selected for special review.
afterApply.qualityAssuranceReview_tr: Başvurular rastgele özel inceleme için seçilebilir.
afterApply.qualityAssuranceReview_zh: 申请可能会被随机抽查进行特殊审查。
afterApply.withdrawal: Can submit a webform to withdraw/cancel; partial fee refund possible depending on processing stage.
afterApply.withdrawal_tr: Geri çekme/iptal için cevrimici form gonderilebilir; isleme asamasina bagli olarak kismi ucret iadesi mumkundur.
afterApply.withdrawal_zh: 可通过在线表单提交撤回/取消申请；是否能部分退费取决于处理阶段。

pilots.name: Rural Community Immigration Pilot (RCIP)
pilots.purpose: Permanent residence for skilled workers wanting to work/settle in rural and remote communities
pilots.purpose_tr: Kırsal ve uzak topluluklarda çalışmak/yerleşmek isteyen nitelikli işçiler için daimi oturum
pilots.purpose_zh: 面向希望在农村和偏远社区工作/定居的技术工人的永久居留项目

pilotSpecificForms.name: Document Checklist - Rural Community Immigration Pilot
Offer of Employment to a Foreign National - RCIP
Recommendation from the Designated Economic Development Organization - RCIP

pilots.languageRequirement: Approved test required, no French-specific mandate
pilots.languageRequirement_tr: Onaylı test gerekir; Fransızca özel zorunluluk yoktur
pilots.languageRequirement_zh: 需要合格的语言测试，没有法语专门要求

pilots.name: Francophone Community Immigration Pilot (FCIP)
pilots.purpose: Permanent residence for skilled workers wanting to work/settle in rural Francophone-minority communities
pilots.purpose_tr: Kırsal Frankofon azınlık topluluklarında çalışmak/yerleşmek isteyen nitelikli işçiler için daimi oturum
pilots.purpose_zh: 面向希望在农村法语少数族裔社区工作/定居的技术工人的永久居留项目

pilotSpecificForms.name: Document Checklist - Francophone Community Immigration Pilot
Offer of Employment to a Foreign National - FCIP
Recommendation from the Designated Economic Development Organization - FCIP

pilots.languageRequirement: Must be able to communicate in French - distinguishing requirement vs. RCIP
pilots.languageRequirement_tr: Fransızca iletişim kurabilmeli; RCIP'den ayıran gereklilik budur
pilots.languageRequirement_zh: 必须能够用法语交流——这是与 RCIP 区分开的要求
pilots.note: Sudbury and Timmins, ON appear in BOTH RCIP and FCIP community lists - flag for UI disambiguation.
pilots.note_tr: Sudbury ve Timmins, ON her iki pilot programın topluluk listesinde de yer alır. Size daha uygun programı belirlemek için iki sayfayı da incelemeniz önerilir.
pilots.note_zh: Sudbury 和 Timmins（ON）同时列在两个试点项目中。建议同时查看两页内容，以判断哪一个更适合您。
